log.reply:
Dear Ms Whitfield,

Thank you for the discovery conversation of 6 October 2026. Tamarack Instruments has a customer service chatbot live on its support portal, an AI visual inspection pilot on the German production line and AI sales forecasting planned for next year. The June 2026 internal audit finding that no inventory of AI systems exists sets a clear starting point. Your objective of having governance in place before visual inspection enters production in Q2 2027 sets the deadline. The Client's existing ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO 9001 management systems offer a foundation to extend rather than replace.

The Executive Briefing would give you, the CISO, the Head of Quality, the Head of Data, the German plant manager and your two internal auditors a shared view of what governance must cover and in what order. We would map the EU AI Act and GDPR to your three use cases across the Netherlands, Germany and the United States. This includes transparency expectations for the chatbot, whether visual inspection could fall within a higher risk category and the AI literacy expectations already in effect. These are expectations to verify with counsel, not legal advice. Because no US drivers were identified, US topics will appear only as general landscape items. The readiness discussion would examine how an AI system inventory can sit within your current management systems as groundwork for the ISO/IEC 42001 effort planned for next year. It would also cover how the EU customer data requirement and works council consultation shape the path to production. The operating model draws on the GRC Workbook (https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) and Slow AI Kitchen (https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen), with board-layer material from AI Governance for Boards (https://github.com/rolldabones/ai-governance-for-boards). Three principles frame the session: Slow AI, Informed Intent, Final Liability rests with the Human.

The Briefing runs two hours, live and virtual, at a price of US$3,000. This sits well within the US$80,000 budget approved for this fiscal year. We will schedule a date that suits all seven attendees.

Afterward the Client receives a written follow-up memo recording the decisions surfaced, our readiness observations and three prioritized recommendations with suggested next steps. The Briefing does not confer certification and cannot predict audit or regulatory outcomes. Its purpose is to equip your leadership to make informed decisions.

As a next step, please reply with two or three preferred dates and confirm the attendee list. We suggest holding the session before your 15 December 2026 decision date so its findings can inform that decision.

Kind regards,

Senior AI Governance Consultant
AI Governance Academy

Human-made, for Easy Work, Simply Done.
